title: Cleopatra, 5 dollars

specs.Decoration: antique finish, digital printing, selective gilding, crystal

descriptionPlain: Description Coin featuring the last queen of the Land of the Pharaohs Colors and decoration inspired by ancient Egypt Symbol of determination and strength Standout at the World Money Fair 2025 Renowned for her intellect and extraordinary beauty, Cleopatra masterfully combined politics with a vision of prosperity and glory for her kingdom. She ensured that her legacy would endure through the ages, and the legends of her hidden treasures continue to fascinate archaeologists. Add the Cleopatra coin to your collection and uncover secrets that have stood the test of time, drawing inspiration from the life of this extraordinary queen.
